name: HP Ergo 1600 (D2845A), 21"
notes: No official datasheet found. 93.75 kHz is the maximum the monitor declares in its own EDID (1600x1200@75); higher is untested. Vertical up to 140 Hz verified in practice (800x600@139.84).
